findings.detail: Harness source of truth is deponent.badge + deponent.conformance. Third party cannot check consistency without Deponent. Mission names this as the defect to close.

Live sibling CLAUSES has 16 entries (adds GAK-REDIRECT-DENIED, GAK-NEWLINE-CHAINED, GAK-AUDIT-CONTENT-BLIND). badge.HARNESS_VERSION is gak-conformance/v1.1. Wrapping that module would fork frozen v1 (13 clauses) and change digest identity.

Stranger path is still `python3 -m deponent.badge verify --kernel deponent`. Spec §7.1 / Appendix A–B teach the same. v0 must retarget the documented entrypoint to python3 -m gak_conformance without changing §3–§6 semantics.
Sworn evidence is a 14-clause v1.1 receipt. Out of v0 frozen set. No sworn adapter in the smallest architecture.
Deponent KernelAdapter includes audit_is_content_blind (v1.1). v0 Protocol must match spec §6 only; optional wrapper must not require or forward that method.
